programme.degree: BSc Computer Science (G400), 3 years, September 2027 entry
programme.how_found: web search restricted to birmingham.ac.uk (discovery only) -> course page.
programme.notes: The course page carries English, deadline and fees; international fees and entry requirements depend on a country selector (rendered by script).

english.quote: TOEFL tests taken before January 2026: 80 overall with no less than 19 in Reading, 19 in Listening, 21 in Speaking and 19 in Writing. TOEFL tests taken from January 2026: 4.5 Overall with no less than 4 in each skill IELTS*: 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any band.
english.notes: Course page, 'English language requirements' for international students. Also PTE 64 with no less than 59 in all four skills; Cambridge C1 Advanced 169 (162 per component). Presessional English is an alternative.

gpa.notes: UK route: 'A*AA to include A-level Mathematics grade A' (contextual AAA). International equivalents are behind the country selector ('International entry requirements Additional requirements for select a country...') and were not readable as static text.

deadline.quote: 13 January 2027 Application deadline for September 2027 entry. Applications close at 18:00 GMT.
deadline.notes: UCAS equal-consideration deadline for September 2027 entry; UK and international applicants apply through UCAS ('advice for UK and overseas applicants').

tuition.quote: £33,300 per year for international students for 2027/28
tuition.notes: The international figure sits in the page's embedded data ('internationalFeesContent': stat '£33,300', description 'per year for international students for 2027/28'; header fact box 'Fees (international) £33,300') and is shown only after choosing a country; the static readable text shows the UK figure ('£10,050 per year for domestic (UK) students for 2027/28'). The evidence check may therefore not find the quote. The international fees page says the fee is constant for the duration of the programme.

scholarship_exists.quote: High Fliers Undergraduate Scholarships for Europe Undergraduate.
scholarship_exists.notes: Regional variants (Africa, China, Europe, and others) listed on the international scholarships page with deadlines in June 2026 (the 2026 entry cycle; 2027 entry not yet listed). Competitive; value not read on this page. The page also lists external awards (Chevening, IsDB, GETFund).

scholarship_international.quote: More than £10 million in scholarships is available for international students coming to study at Birmingham.
scholarship_international.notes: Many awards are country- or region-restricted.
